desc:
🎄 Two choices. One festive outfit. What will YOU choose?

🎅 Pick your favourite Christmas items as you climb!
✨ Mix and match cute holiday looks to create your perfect outfit.
🍬 Collect Candy Canes and unlock fun gear.
👗 Save your favourite outfits in your wardrobe.
🏆 Reach the top, claim your win and try a whole new look!

❄️ Enjoy the snowfall — or switch it off whenever you like!

👍 Having fun? Leave a like and favourite the game!
💬 Found a bug or have an idea? Share your honest feedback at the finish — it helps us make the game better!

📌 Outfits are for use inside this experience.
